_loader_notes: First-time guides for core and carry exercises. Same structure as content/exercise-guides/lower-body.json.
if_its_taken.swaps lists only genuinely similar exercises, and may be empty. The swap engine should use these lists instead of the catalogue alternatives.
Draft for coach review before launch.

guides.where_to_find: Any mat in the stretching area or a quiet corner.
setup: Lie on your back with your arms pointing to the ceiling.
Lift your knees so they're bent at 90 degrees over your hips.
form_cues: Gently press your lower back into the mat and keep it there.
Slowly lower one arm behind you and the opposite leg towards the floor.
Return and switch sides.
guides.where_you_should_feel_it: Deep in your stomach, around your belly button.
common_mistakes: Lower back arching off the mat. Make the movement smaller.
Holding your breath. Breathe out as you lower.

guides.where_to_find: Any mat in the stretching area or a quiet corner.
setup: Kneel on all fours, hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
form_cues: Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are straight.
Keep your hips level, as if balancing a cup of tea on your back.
Return slowly and switch sides.
guides.where_you_should_feel_it: Your core and the muscles along your back.
common_mistakes: Twisting your hips as your leg lifts.
Rushing. Slow is harder and better.

guides.where_to_find: Any mat in the stretching area or a quiet corner.
setup: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder.
Bend your knees to start, or straighten your legs to make it harder.
form_cues: Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line.
Keep your hips stacked, not rolling forward or back.
Breathe steadily throughout.
common_mistakes: Elbow too far from your shoulder.

guides.where_to_find: Any mat in the stretching area or a quiet corner.
setup: Lie face down and prop yourself up on your forearms, elbows under your shoulders.
Start on your knees, or on your toes to make it harder.
form_cues: Lift your body into a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and gently pull your belly button in.
Keep breathing.

guides.where_to_find: The cable station: a tall frame with adjustable pulleys.
setup: Set a pulley to chest height with a single handle.
Stand side-on to the machine, hold the handle at your chest with both hands and step away until the cable is tight.
form_cues: Press the handle straight out in front of you.
Don't let the cable twist you towards the machine.
Bring it back to your chest slowly.
guides.where_you_should_feel_it: The sides of your waist, working to stop you turning.
common_mistakes: Standing too close, so there's no tension.

if_its_taken.tip: If the cables are busy, a side plank trains the same muscles.

guides.where_to_find: The cable station: a tall frame with adjustable pulleys.
setup: Attach a rope to the highest pulley.
Kneel facing the machine and hold the rope beside your head.
form_cues: Curl your ribs down towards your hips.
Keep your hips still; don't sit back onto your heels.
Return slowly until your back is long.
common_mistakes: Pulling with your arms. Keep them fixed beside your head.
Bending at the hips instead of curling your spine.

if_its_taken.tip: If the cables are busy, reverse crunches on a mat work the same muscles.

guides.where_to_find: Any mat in the stretching area or a quiet corner.
setup: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet off the floor.
Arms by your sides, palms down.
form_cues: Curl your hips off the mat, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Lower slowly.
Use your stomach, not momentum.
guides.where_you_should_feel_it: The lower part of your stomach.

guides.where_to_find: A captain's chair (a tall frame with arm pads) in the machine area, or a pull-up bar.
setup: Stand on the captain's chair with your forearms on the pads and back against the backrest.
Let your legs hang straight down.
form_cues: Lift your knees towards your chest.
Curl your hips up slightly at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
common_mistakes: Only lifting to hip height. Curl a little higher.

if_its_taken.tip: If the captain's chair is taken, reverse crunches on a mat work the same muscles.

guides.where_to_find: The dumbbell rack, with a clear path of a few metres.
setup: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand.
Stand tall with your shoulders back.
form_cues: Walk slowly with short, steady steps.
Keep your shoulders level and your chest up.
Put the dumbbells down carefully at the end.
guides.where_you_should_feel_it: Your grip, shoulders and whole middle.

if_its_taken.tip: No space to walk? March slowly on the spot holding the dumbbells.

guides.where_to_find: The dumbbell rack, with a clear path of a few metres.
setup: Pick up one heavy dumbbell in one hand, like a suitcase.
form_cues: Walk slowly and stay upright.
Don't lean towards or away from the weight.
Switch hands and repeat.
guides.where_you_should_feel_it: The side of your waist and your grip.

if_its_taken.tip: No space to walk? Hold the dumbbell and march slowly on the spot.
